systems.system: Municipal identity cards and civil records
systems.owner: municipalities and the Banadir Regional Administration
systems.tiers: identity cards and birth certificates issued by municipal offices in Baidoa and by regional and district offices in Mogadishu; Mogadishu municipality produces some birth, death and marriage records; a few other mayors' registration systems were 'localised and did not function well' (citing the World Bank, 2016); the report does not say whether any of it is computerised
a humanitarian beneficiary register in use in Somalia since 2015, holding over 4 million individuals; not a government system

note: A report on identity documents and land rights; municipalities and district offices appear as issuers of documents and allocators of land, with nothing stated about their offices' connection.
